renderedTexts: 雨后泥土散发的清新气味，常带一点泥土和植物的香味；有时指这种气味的成因或现象
The distinctive, earthy scent that rises from dry soil when rain falls after a dry spell, often associated with the smell of damp earth and plants.
After the storm, the scent of petrichor hung in the cool air.
暴风雨过后，凉爽的空气中弥漫着雨后泥土的清香。
The first drops of rain released the petrichor from the dry garden.
